body:
CANONICAL, continued: live TermAl host workarounds for Engram agents (Engram::Fable; rev 2, 2026-11-03 08:12Z). termal-host-workarounds is at its size limit (rev 97); read both. Each line names the item whose fix retires it.

!! NEVER RERUN ON "UNKNOWN" (P1 TermAl w-96480bbbe221, inverse of w-881c69c0ccdb): TermAl can close a check as Unknown at turn end while its launcher run is STILL RUNNING, and can show a finished check as running. Its notice may even say "run it again".
- Read the launcher's results.json in .git/worktrees/<root>/review-runs/<run-id>/.
- A live executor pid with a fresh heartbeat means running; a terminal state is the result.
- Never rerun, or ask for a new slot, on a TermAl status alone. Never rerun only for TermAl credit.

- TermAl HOST CREDIT IS NOT A LANDING CONDITION. A remote run of the standard launcher on a bundle of the exact candidate commit gates the landing through the integration owner's record on the item: run id, host, commit, tree, before and after fingerprints (TermAl w-5e2f3fba987a, sibling w-b142376c70c3). A run in a shared root that covers two items credits only one (w-db79607d5b15).
- STALE WORK REVISION (TermAl w-c43760ef6a60): TermAl's run registration carries the CLAIM-TIME work_revision. A revise after claiming makes Engram refuse the verification record: verification_record_refused, field work_revision. TermAl drops the reason (w-c6ad7b63270d). Avoid revising a held item before its credited run.
- SOURCE ROOT "UNCONFIRMED" recurs after a re-name (TermAl w-426dcbda4467; joint fix design 07:01Z). It never blocks actions. A session waiting for "next turn" needs a continuation message.
- REMOTE RUNNERS AFTER A QUARANTINE OR RESTART:
  - ENDs may be delayed by 409 or 503, then re-delivered with the same key (w-c03ce2f854e8); don't rerun.
  - A runner may ADMIT requests queued before the quarantine (w-4226eb67e0f9), so withdraw stale requests explicitly.
  - Relay mail to runners often shows durableButNotWoken.
- LAUNCHER STOP is Windows-only until Engram w-efec5adad667 lands. A superseded but healthy run is left to finish, then only that run is cleaned up. A HUNG run with no supported stop is ended only with the coordinator's authorization: evidence first (process tree with pid, ppid, pgid, command and executable; lsof; sample; results and logs), then SIGTERM, then SIGKILL, on individual pids that descend from that run's own executor and run from that job's own worktree, target or temp home. Never killpg a group you didn't create; never the installed engram, a live engram mcp or control process, TermAl, or another job. (First use: Mac 6201, run test-a468bc75, 08:12Z.)
- STALE STOP AT A RUNNER: if a runner cites a stale Greg STOP, the coordinator answers directly with Greg's later words and their sources (DL560 session-4, relay #70/#71).
- A git bundle of the exact commit, mailed to a runner, needs no test ref (rules-remote-test-runs-2026-10-31 §2). Use Windows B for Windows-only proofs: it's back since 07:32Z, after w-4f6e closed.
